s0401.literal: Ala Haiya entered Jiangling and sent emissaries by separate routes to summon and instruct unsubdued prefectures and districts; Zhao Zhen, prefect of Xia Prefecture; Zhao Zai, prefect of Gui Prefecture; Mao Jun, acting pacification commissioner of Feng Prefecture; Lu Xiwen, chief controller of Xincheng in Changde Prefecture; Zhou Gongming, acting prefect of the old city; and others all surrendered their cities.
s0401.idiomatic: Ala Haiya entered Jiangling and dispatched emissaries along separate routes to win over unsubdued prefectures and districts. Zhao Zhen of Xia Prefecture, Zhao Zai of Gui Prefecture, Mao Jun acting for Feng Prefecture, Lu Xiwen chief controller of Xincheng in Changde, Zhou Gongming acting prefect of the old city, and others all surrendered.

s0402.literal: On xinhai day envoys were sent to summon and instruct Song Five Prefectures Pacification Commissioner Lu Wenfu to surrender.
s0402.idiomatic: On xinhai day envoys were sent to summon Song Five Prefectures pacification commissioner Lu Wenfu to surrender.

s0403.literal: On jiayin day the Central Secretariat was instructed to deliberate on establishing a Petition Drum; if one's parents, siblings, or spouse had been killed and one had grievance with nowhere to appeal, one would be permitted to come and strike it.
s0403.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Central Secretariat was told to consider establishing a Petition Drum: where parents, siblings, or a spouse had been murdered and there was no other avenue of appeal, the aggrieved would be allowed to come and strike it.

s0404.literal: Those who abruptly brought trifling matters would be dealt with according to law.
s0404.idiomatic: Anyone who abused the drum with trivial complaints would be punished according to law.

s0405.literal: On xinyou day Song pacification commissioners Zhao Meng of Ying Prefecture and Zhai Gui of Fu Prefecture surrendered their cities.
s0405.idiomatic: On xinyou day Song pacification commissioners Zhao Meng of Ying Prefecture and Zhai Gui of Fu Prefecture surrendered their cities.

s0406.literal: Song Minister of Revenue Wu Jun sent a letter to Xu Wang Rong and others at Jiankang, relaying words of his chancellor Chen Yizhong, requesting a ceasefire and friendly relations.
s0406.idiomatic: Song minister of revenue Wu Jun wrote to Xu Wang Rong and others at Jiankang, relaying chancellor Chen Yizhong's request for a ceasefire and restored good relations.

s0407.literal: Bayan sent Central Secretariat deliberation official Zhang Yu, Huainan West Branch Secretariat clerk Wang Zhang, together with the Song envoy Ma Yu, bearing Xu Wang Rong's reply to the relay station at Pingjiang Prefecture — all were killed by the Song.
s0407.idiomatic: Bayan sent deliberation official Zhang Yu of the Central Secretariat and Huainan West branch clerk Wang Zhang, together with the Song envoy Ma Yu, to deliver Xu Wang Rong's reply to the relay station at Pingjiang Prefecture; the Song killed them all.

s0408.literal: On guihai day Aju's army was stationed at Guazhou, forty-five li from Yangzhou; the Song Huaidong Pacification Commission burned all buildings in the city and relocated the inhabitants before departing.
s0408.idiomatic: On guihai day Aju's army encamped at Guazhou, forty-five li from Yangzhou. The Song Huaidong pacification commission burned the city's buildings, moved the people out, and withdrew.

s0409.literal: Aju established tower stockades and war equipment to hold it.
s0409.idiomatic: Aju built tower stockades and siege equipment to hold the place.

s0410.literal: On bingyin day the Imperial Livestock Commission was established.
s0410.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Imperial Livestock Commission was established.

s0411.literal: Surrendered ministers including Ding Shun were granted clothing.
s0411.idiomatic: Surrendered officials including Ding Shun were granted clothing.

s0412.literal: This year's silk and silver levies on the capital region's people were remitted.
s0412.idiomatic: This year's silk and silver levies on the capital region were remitted.

s0413.literal: On dingmao day Boluo, grand minister of agriculture and censor-in-chief, was made censor grandee.
s0413.idiomatic: On dingmao day Boluo, grand minister of agriculture and censor-in-chief, was made censor grandee.

s0414.literal: The route-by-route itinerant agricultural promotion officials were abolished, and their duties were transferred to the judicial investigation and inspection commissions.
s0414.idiomatic: Itinerant agricultural promotion officials in each route were abolished and their duties transferred to the judicial investigation and inspection commissions.

s0415.literal: Sundry persons left over at temples were registered.
s0415.idiomatic: Unregistered persons lingering at temples were brought onto the rolls.

s0416.literal: On gengwu day Gao Da was made vice grand councillor, and an edict was also issued to comfort and instruct him.
s0416.idiomatic: On gengwu day Gao Da was made vice grand councillor, and an edict was issued to comfort and instruct him.

s0417.literal: Langzhong Wang Shiying of the Ministry of War and Langzhong Xiao Yu of the Ministry of Justice were dispatched with an edict summoning Zhang Zongyan, the fortieth-generation Celestial Master of the Succession Han, to court.
s0417.idiomatic: Wang Shiying of the Ministry of War and Xiao Yu of the Ministry of Justice were sent with an edict summoning Zhang Zongyan, the fortieth-generation Celestial Master of the Succession Han, to court.

s0418.literal: On the xinwei new moon of the fifth month Ala Haiya presented as tribute one thousand boys and girls and ten thousand cattle he had captured.
s0418.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon of the fifth month Ala Haiya presented one thousand captive boys and girls and ten thousand cattle.

s0419.literal: The Privy Council reported: "At Xia Prefecture war vessels ought to block the strategic river crossings.
s0419.idiomatic: The Privy Council reported, "At Xia Prefecture war vessels should block the strategic crossings.

s0420.literal: Furthermore garrison troops in Ying and Fu prefectures are insufficient; it is proposed to select five thousand seven hundred men from Xiangyang and other places, place them under the mobile Central Secretariat, and allow Ala Haiya to deploy them."
s0420.idiomatic: Garrisons at Ying and Fu are also too weak; five thousand seven hundred men should be chosen from Xiangyang and elsewhere, placed under the mobile Central Secretariat, and left to Ala Haiya's command."

s0422.literal: An edict ordered Right Vice Director Lian Xixian and Vice Grand Councillor Tob Qorqutua to administer the mobile Central Secretariat at Jiangling Prefecture, and Ala Haiya returned to E Prefecture.
s0422.idiomatic: An edict ordered right vice director Lian Xixian and vice grand councillor Tob Qorqutua to administer the mobile Central Secretariat at Jiangling, and Ala Haiya returned to E Prefecture.

s0423.literal: Three relay stations from Xiangyang to Jingnan were established.
s0423.idiomatic: Three relay stations from Xiangyang to Jingnan were established.

s0424.literal: On dingchou day Aju built a wooden stockade at Yangzi Bridge, cutting the Huaidong grain route and also shielding Guazhou.
s0424.idiomatic: On dingchou day Aju built a wooden stockade at Yangzi Bridge, severing the Huaidong grain route and shielding Guazhou.

s0425.literal: On gengchen day an edict addressed Vice Grand Councillor Gao Da: "In the past when our state marched out on campaign, cities we took we left as soon as we departed them, never placing garrison troops to hold them — hence campaigns year after year without ceasing.
s0425.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict addressed vice grand councillor Gao Da: "In past campaigns our state took cities and then abandoned them, never leaving garrisons behind — and so war dragged on year after year.

s0426.literal: Those who contend for a state take only land and people; though one gains the territory without the people, who is to dwell in it?
s0426.idiomatic: Those who fight for a realm want land and people; what use is territory without inhabitants?

s0427.literal: Now you wish to hold newly attached city walls and enable the people to settle in their occupations and farm — the Mongols do not yet understand this.
s0427.idiomatic: You mean to hold newly submitted cities and let the people settle and farm — the Mongols do not yet grasp that.

s0428.literal: You know this business well; you should apply yourself to it with vigor.
s0428.idiomatic: You understand this work; apply yourself to it with all your strength.

s0429.literal: All prefectures and districts in Hunan were once your subordinates; how to win over those not yet submitted and how the living people may settle in their occupations — leave it to you to accomplish."
s0429.idiomatic: The Hunan prefectures were once your command; how to win over those still holding out and how to settle the people — that is for you to decide."

s0430.literal: Song Jiading Pacification Commissioner Zan Wanshou sent his subordinate general Li Li with a letter requesting surrender, saying he had repeatedly incurred guilt and begging to be pardoned.
s0430.idiomatic: Song Jiading pacification commissioner Zan Wanshou sent his officer Li Li with a letter offering surrender, saying he had repeatedly offended and begging pardon.

s0431.literal: An edict ordered envoys sent to summon and instruct him.
s0431.idiomatic: An edict ordered envoys sent to summon him.

s0432.literal: On xinsi day Song prefect of Chen Prefecture Lü Wenxing, Fu Anguo acting for Sui Prefecture at Huangxian Cave, Xu Ding acting for Jun Prefecture at Xianren Stockade, Wen Yonggui prefect of Yuan Prefecture, Kang Yu prefect of Jing Prefecture, Li Jian prefect of Fang Prefecture, and others all surrendered their cities.
s0432.idiomatic: On xinsi day Song officials Lü Wenxing of Chen Prefecture, Fu Anguo acting for Sui at Huangxian Cave, Xu Ding acting for Jun at Xianren Stockade, Wen Yonggui of Yuan Prefecture, Kang Yu of Jing Prefecture, Li Jian of Fang Prefecture, and others all surrendered their cities.

s0433.literal: In Jingnan-Hubei Circuit they had in all gained three prefectures, eleven zhou, four armies, fifty-seven counties, eight hundred three thousand four hundred fifteen households, and one million one hundred forty-three thousand eight hundred sixty persons.
s0433.idiomatic: In Jingnan-Hubei Circuit they had taken three fu, eleven zhou, four armies, and fifty-seven counties, with eight hundred three thousand four hundred fifteen households and one million one hundred forty-three thousand eight hundred sixty persons.

s0434.literal: On bingxu day newly attached raw-coupon troops of the three guards were sent to garrison-farm at Badaw Mountain.
s0434.idiomatic: On bingxu day newly attached raw-coupon troops of the three guards were sent to farm garrison duty at Badaw Mountain.

s0435.literal: On dinghai day Bayan was summoned to court; Mongol wanhu Alaghan was appointed to administer mobile Central Secretariat affairs; and Suzhou darughachi Asa was sent to conscript troops in Hexi.
s0435.idiomatic: On dinghai day Bayan was summoned to court; Mongol wanhu Alaghan was placed in charge of mobile Central Secretariat affairs; and Suzhou darughachi Asa was sent to conscript troops in Hexi.

s0436.literal: Wanhu Aisan Buqa defied Bayan's command and on his own authority withdrew garrison troops; an edict ordered his tally and seal seized and him sent to serve in the army to redeem himself.
s0436.idiomatic: Wanhu Aisan Buqa defied Bayan's orders and withdrew garrison troops on his own authority; an edict stripped him of tally and seal and sent him to serve in the army to redeem himself.

s0437.literal: Huaidong Pacification Commissioner Chen Yan requested to resign office and observe mourning for three years; it was not permitted.
s0437.idiomatic: Huaidong pacification commissioner Chen Yan asked to resign and observe three years of mourning; the request was denied.

s0438.literal: The prohibition on slaughtering cattle and horses was strictly enforced.
s0438.idiomatic: The ban on slaughtering cattle and horses was strictly enforced.

s0439.literal: On gengyin day Song Five Prefectures Pacification Commissioner Lu Wenfu came to surrender.
s0439.idiomatic: On gengyin day Song Five Prefectures pacification commissioner Lu Wenfu came to surrender.

s0440.literal: On renchen day Song Commander-in-Chief Liu Shiyong and palace guard commander Zhang Yan held Changzhou.
s0440.idiomatic: On renchen day Song commander-in-chief Liu Shiyong and palace guard commander Zhang Yan held Changzhou.

s0441.literal: On guisi day the King of Goryeo Wang Chŏn was instructed to summon remnants of the Jin Island faction who were in Tamna.
s0441.idiomatic: On guisi day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo was instructed to summon Jin Island remnant bands in Tamna.

s0442.literal: On the gengzi new moon of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.
s0442.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

s0443.literal: Song Jiading Pacification Commissioner Zan Wanshou surrendered his city; he was granted the name Shun.
s0443.idiomatic: Song Jiading pacification commissioner Zan Wanshou surrendered his city and was granted the name Shun.

s0444.literal: On guimao day Grand Commander Fan Wenhu of Two Zhe was dispatched with an edict to instruct garrison officials, troops, and civilians at Anfeng, Shou Prefecture, Zhaoxin, Wuhe, and other places;
s0444.idiomatic: On guimao day Fan Wenhu, grand commander of Two Zhe, was sent with an edict to instruct garrison officials, troops, and civilians at Anfeng, Shou Prefecture, Zhaoxin, Wuhe, and other places;

s0445.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Boshi was sent to instruct Zhu Shunsun that because of age and illness he could not attend court audiences and was temporarily to remain in the capital — he need not doubt or fear.
s0445.idiomatic: Vice minister of justice Boshi was sent to tell Zhu Shunsun that, being old and ill, he need not attend court and might remain in the capital for the time being without fear.

s0446.literal: Lian Xixian and others were instructed that property confiscated from Qingyang Mengyan and Li Shen should if registered be restored, and their families moved to the capital.
s0446.idiomatic: Lian Xixian and others were told that property previously seized from Qingyang Mengyan and Li Shen should be restored where it could be accounted for, and their families moved to the capital.

s0447.literal: On jiachen day wanhu Alaghan was made vice grand councillor of the mobile Central Secretariat.
s0447.idiomatic: On jiachen day wanhu Alaghan was made vice grand councillor of the mobile Central Secretariat.

s0448.literal: Zhang Zhang, prefect of Kai Prefecture, was captured and his crime pardoned.
s0448.idiomatic: Zhang Zhang, prefect of Kai Prefecture, was captured and pardoned.

s0449.literal: His two sons Zhu and Ji had come to surrender first; because of his sons he was spared death.
s0449.idiomatic: His sons Zhu and Ji had surrendered first; because of them he was spared execution.

s0450.literal: An order directed Shili Bo and Shi Shu to lead two thousand veteran-coupon troops from Xiangyang and two thousand sturdy hunters, together with Fan Wenhu, to summon Anfeng Army; each was granted ten horses.
s0450.idiomatic: An order directed Shili Bo and Shi Shu to lead two thousand Xiangyang veteran-coupon troops and two thousand sturdy hunters, together with Fan Wenhu, to summon Anfeng Army; each received ten horses.

s0451.literal: Nineteen men who had formerly served under Grand Councillor Shi Tianze asked to announce rewards in the army and were ordered to accompany Shu.
s0451.idiomatic: Nineteen men who had once served under grand councillor Shi Tianze asked to announce rewards in camp and were ordered to go with Shi Shu.

s0452.literal: On wushen day younger brothers and sons of darughachis in the Pingyang, Xijing, and Yan'an routes were conscripted as soldiers.
s0452.idiomatic: On wushen day younger brothers and sons of darughachis in the Pingyang, Xijing, and Yan'an routes were conscripted as soldiers.

s0453.literal: On xinhai day thirty-five men under Prince Ulug who had won merit at Jiandu were rewarded with graded amounts of silver notes; Ulug guardsmen were allotted two horses each and attendants one each.
s0453.idiomatic: On xinhai day thirty-five men under Prince Ulug who had won merit at Jiandu received graded silver-note rewards; Ulug guardsmen were allotted two horses each and attendants one.

s0454.literal: The Huaidong Marshal's Headquarters was ordered to deploy troops, together with E Prefecture garrison troops and Li Dan's former followers, and also ten thousand men previously conscripted in Henan who had later been released as civilians — all were re-registered as soldiers and placed under the mobile Central Secretariat.
s0454.idiomatic: The Huaidong marshal's headquarters was ordered to deploy troops, together with E Prefecture garrisons and Li Dan's old followers, and also ten thousand Henan conscripts later released to civilian status — all were re-registered as soldiers and placed under the mobile Central Secretariat.

s0455.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered envoys sent to summon Song Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Zhao Dingying: "Recently Bi Zaixing and Qingyang Mengyan came to court and in person reported affairs of the Sichuan frontier, memorializing to slow the advance and allow voluntary submission — for now their request is granted.
s0455.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered envoys sent to summon Song Sichuan pacification commissioner Zhao Dingying: "Bi Zaixing and Qingyang Mengyan recently came to court and reported Sichuan frontier affairs in person, asking that the advance be slowed so they might submit voluntarily — for now that request is granted.

s0456.literal: Now Zaixing is sent to proclaim our great faith; if you can adapt to the times you may preserve wealth and honor — do not bring ruin upon the living people and invite regret upon yourself."
s0456.idiomatic: Zaixing is now sent to proclaim our good faith; if you adapt to the times you may keep wealth and rank — do not ruin the people and regret it afterward."

s0457.literal: On gengshen day Bi Zaixing, Chongqing Prefecture pacification commissioner, was sent with an edict to summon Song Jie Prefecture military commissioner Zhang Yu, Jiang'an-Tongchuan pacification commissioner Zhang Chaozong, Fu Prefecture inspector Yang Li, and Liangshan Army defender Ma Ye.
s0457.idiomatic: On gengshen day Bi Zaixing, Chongqing prefecture pacification commissioner, was sent with an edict to summon Song Jie Prefecture military commissioner Zhang Yu, Jiang'an-Tongchuan pacification commissioner Zhang Chaozong, Fu Prefecture inspector Yang Li, and Liangshan Army defender Ma Ye.

s0458.literal: On xinyou day Song Tongchuan Pacification Commissioner and Jiang'an Prefect Mei Yingchun surrendered his city.
s0458.idiomatic: On xinyou day Song Tongchuan pacification commissioner and Jiang'an prefect Mei Yingchun surrendered his city.

s0459.literal: On yichou day newly attached men including Ding Shun of Lian and Hai were used to requisition one thousand vessels and send them to the Huaidong Grand Marshal's Headquarters.
s0459.idiomatic: On yichou day newly attached men including Ding Shun of Lian and Hai were used to requisition one thousand ships and send them to the Huaidong grand marshal's headquarters.

s0460.literal: On bingyin day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai and deputy general Zhang Lin with twenty thousand infantry and cavalry attacked the wooden stockade at Yangzi Bridge by night.
s0460.idiomatic: On bingyin day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai and deputy general Zhang Lin led twenty thousand infantry and cavalry in a night attack on the wooden stockade at Yangzi Bridge.

s0461.literal: Wanhu Shi Bi at the stockade sent urgent word; Aju marched from Guazhou with troops to relieve him.
s0461.idiomatic: Wanhu Shi Bi at the stockade sent urgent word; Aju marched from Guazhou with troops to relieve him.

s0462.literal: At dawn he reached the stockade; Jiang Cai's army drew up a formation straddling the water; Aju directed cavalry to cross and attack, but the formation held firm.
s0462.idiomatic: At dawn he reached the stockade. Jiang Cai's army formed up astride the water; Aju sent cavalry across to attack, but the line held firm.

s0463.literal: Aju's army withdrew; Jiang Cai's troops pressed forward; our army fought at full strength and Jiang Cai's army fled.
s0463.idiomatic: Aju's army feigned withdrawal; Jiang Cai pressed forward; our troops fought hard and Jiang Cai's army broke and fled.

s0464.literal: Aju's infantry and cavalry advanced together and routed them utterly; Jiang Cai barely escaped with his life, Zhang Lin was captured alive, and eighteen thousand heads were taken.
s0464.idiomatic: Aju's infantry and cavalry advanced together and routed them; Jiang Cai barely escaped, Zhang Lin was captured alive, and eighteen thousand heads were taken.

s0465.literal: On wuchen day Tachu was ordered to lead the two armies of Atahai and Yesudai'er to Lianshui.
s0465.idiomatic: On wuchen day Tachu was ordered to lead the armies of Atahai and Yesudai'er to Lianshui.

s0466.literal: Son Tan was made darughachi of Tamna.
s0466.idiomatic: Son Tan was made darughachi of Tamna.

s0467.literal: The Shandong Pacification Commission was abolished.
s0467.idiomatic: The Shandong pacification commission was abolished.

s0468.literal: On the gengwu new moon of the seventh month of autumn Aju assembled branch secretariat wanhu warships at Guazhou; Atahai and Dong Wenbing assembled branch commission wanhu warships at Xijin Crossing; Song Riverine Pacification Commissioner Zhao Yin, Privy Council chief secretary Zhang Shijie, Taizhou prefect Sun Huchen, and others deployed their fleets north and south of Jiao Mountain.
s0468.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the seventh month of autumn Aju assembled branch secretariat wanhu warships at Guazhou; Atahai and Dong Wenbing assembled branch commission wanhu warships at Xijin Crossing; Song riverine pacification commissioner Zhao Yin, privy council chief secretary Zhang Shijie, Taizhou prefect Sun Huchen, and others lined up their fleets north and south of Jiao Mountain.

s0469.literal: Aju dispatched wanhu Zhang Hongfan and others with one thousand Badu war vessels to raid westward along the Zhujin Sands.
s0469.idiomatic: Aju dispatched wanhu Zhang Hongfan and others with one thousand Badu war vessels to raid west along the Zhujin Sands.

s0470.literal: On xinwei day Aju and Atahai ascended Shigong Mountain on the south bank and directed the armies; naval wanhu Liu Chen was to follow the south bank eastward toward Jia Beach and circle behind the enemy;
s0470.idiomatic: On xinwei day Aju and Atahai climbed Shigong Mountain on the south bank and directed the armies: naval wanhu Liu Chen was to follow the south bank east to Jia Beach and circle behind the enemy;

s0471.literal: Dong Wenbing was to strike straight to the southern foot of Jiao Mountain and pin their right flank;
s0471.idiomatic: Dong Wenbing was to strike the southern foot of Jiao Mountain and pin their right;

s0472.literal: Pacification Commissioner Liu Guojie was to press their left;
s0472.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Liu Guojie was to press their left;

s0473.literal: Wanhu Hulachu was to thrust at their center;
s0473.idiomatic: Wanhu Hulachu was to thrust at their center;

s0474.literal: Zhang Hongfan, following from upstream, was to press toward the north of Jiao Mountain.
s0474.idiomatic: Zhang Hongfan, coming from upstream, was to press toward the north of Jiao Mountain.

s0475.literal: The great battle ran from chen hour to wu hour; battle cries shook heaven and earth; taking the wind they shot fire arrows at the bamboo-mat sails.
s0475.idiomatic: The great battle ran from chen hour to wu hour; shouts shook heaven and earth; riding the wind they shot fire arrows into the bamboo-mat sails.

s0476.literal: The Song army was routed utterly; Shijie, Huchen, and others all fled.
s0476.idiomatic: The Song army was routed; Shijie, Huchen, and others all fled.

s0477.literal: The pursuit reached Tushan and captured several hundred yellow-crane and white-hawk vessels.
s0477.idiomatic: The pursuit reached Tushan and captured several hundred yellow-crane and white-hawk vessels.

s0478.literal: From then on the Song could no longer field armies.
s0478.idiomatic: From then on the Song could no longer field armies.

s0479.literal: The next day Song Pingjiang commander Liu Shiyong and palace guard commander Zhang Yan, with the Two Zhe Pacification Commission army, reached Lücheng and were again defeated by Atahai's branch commission troops.
s0479.idiomatic: The next day Song Pingjiang commander Liu Shiyong and palace guard commander Zhang Yan, with the Two Zhe pacification commission army, reached Lücheng and were again defeated by Atahai's branch commission troops.

s0480.literal: On renshen day ten thousand troops from Yunnan's Luoluo, Punahong, and other places were conscripted and placed under the mobile Central Secretariat.
s0480.idiomatic: On renshen day ten thousand troops from Yunnan's Luoluo, Punahong, and other places were conscripted and placed under the mobile Central Secretariat.

s0481.literal: On guiyou day Venus infringed upon the Well asterism.
s0481.idiomatic: On guiyou day Venus infringed upon the Well asterism.

s0482.literal: An edict ordered the taking of unsubmitted tribes in Chaghanzhang.
s0482.idiomatic: An edict ordered the reduction of unsubmitted tribes in Chaghanzhang.

s0483.literal: On dingchou day five water relay stations from Wei Prefecture to Yangcun were established.
s0483.idiomatic: On dingchou day five water relay stations from Wei Prefecture to Yangcun were established.

s0484.literal: On jimao day the Yan South-Hebei Circuit Judicial Investigation and Inspection Commission was added.
s0484.idiomatic: On jimao day a Yan South-Hebei judicial investigation and inspection commission was added.

s0485.literal: Four hundred Mongol troops from the Cai Prefecture relay station were placed under Ala Haiya, and six hundred Han troops followed wanhu Song Dudu to Jiangxi.
s0485.idiomatic: Four hundred Mongol troops from the Cai Prefecture relay station were placed under Ala Haiya, and six hundred Han troops followed wanhu Song Dudu to Jiangxi.

s0486.literal: On renwu day envoys were sent to summon Song Huaian Pacification Commissioner Zhu Huan.
s0486.idiomatic: On renwu day envoys were sent to summon Song Huaian pacification commissioner Zhu Huan.

s0487.literal: On guiwei day an edict ordered envoys sent to Jiangnan to search out Confucian scholars, physicians, monks, Daoists, yin-yang specialists, and the like.
s0487.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict ordered envoys sent to Jiangnan to search out Confucian scholars, physicians, monks, Daoists, yin-yang specialists, and the like.

s0488.literal: Bayan, left chancellor, was ordered to lead the generals straight toward Lin'an;
s0488.idiomatic: Left chancellor Bayan was ordered to lead the generals straight toward Lin'an;

s0489.literal: Right Vice Director Ala Haiya was to take Hunan;
s0489.idiomatic: Right vice director Ala Haiya was to take Hunan;

s0490.literal: Mongol wanhu Song Dudu, Han wanhu Wu Xiu, Zhang Rongshi, and Li Heng, with Minister of War Lü Shichao administering the Grand Marshal's Headquarters, were to take Jiangxi.
s0490.idiomatic: Mongol wanhu Song Dudu, Han wanhu Wu Xiu, Zhang Rongshi, and Li Heng, with minister of war Lü Shichao administering the grand marshal's headquarters, were to take Jiangxi.

s0491.literal: The Huainan West Mobile Privy Council was abolished; Right Vice Director Atahai and Vice Councillor Dong Wenbing jointly administered mobile Central Secretariat affairs.
s0491.idiomatic: The Huainan West mobile privy council was abolished; right vice director Atahai and vice councillor Dong Wenbing jointly administered mobile Central Secretariat affairs.

s0492.literal: On xinmao day the moon infringed upon the Net asterism.
s0492.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon infringed upon the Net asterism.

s0493.literal: On jiawu day envoys were sent with an edict to summon Song Li Tingzhi and Xia Gui.
s0493.idiomatic: On jiawu day envoys were sent with an edict to summon Song Li Tingzhi and Xia Gui.

s0494.literal: Bayan was made right chancellor of the Central Secretariat and Aju left chancellor.
s0494.idiomatic: Bayan was made right chancellor of the Central Secretariat and Aju left chancellor.

s0495.literal: On the jihai new moon of the eighth month this year's silk and silver levies in the Beijing, Xijing, and Shaanxi routes were remitted.
s0495.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the eighth month this year's silk and silver levies in the Beijing, Xijing, and Shaanxi routes were remitted.

s0496.literal: On guimao day Bayan took leave at court and marched south, bearing an edict instructing the Song sovereign and ministers that if they came to submit together the Zhao clan could be kept secure and their ancestral temples allowed to remain as before.
s0496.idiomatic: On guimao day Bayan took leave at court and marched south with an edict telling the Song sovereign and ministers that if they submitted together the Zhao clan would be kept safe and their ancestral temples left as before.

s0497.literal: Wang Rugui, son of the late envoy to Dali Wang Junhou, was granted a rank-eight office.
s0497.idiomatic: Wang Rugui, son of the late envoy to Dali Wang Junhou, was granted a rank-eight office.

s0498.literal: On jiwei day Rencheng County was raised to Ji Prefecture.
s0498.idiomatic: On jiwei day Rencheng County was raised to Ji Prefecture.

s0499.literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
s0499.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

s0500.literal: On bingyin day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his Deputy Privy Councillor Xu Qiong and General Zhao Gui to congratulate on the Sage's Birth Festival.
s0500.idiomatic: On bingyin day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent deputy privy councillor Xu Qiong and general Zhao Gui to congratulate on the Sage's Birth Festival.
